Paragraph: "Those blooming lotuses remind me of Seetha's radiant face and delicate eyes, making her absence even harder to bear..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: The lotus flower serves as a direct visual memory trigger for Seetha's beauty, deepening Rama's pain.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama connects nature's beauty directly to his memory of Seetha.
Outcome/Resolution: A natural object transforms into a poignant reminder of personal loss.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Upamana (Metaphorical comparison where the object of beauty evokes the divine beloved)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Every beautiful element in nature points back to the supreme source of beauty (Seetha), inspiring constant remembrance.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Associative memory trigger: visual similarity between natural objects and a loved one reactivates intense relational longing.
